user.title: Connect to MQTT broker
user.description: Enter the Rubetek MQTT broker address. The integration will connect directly and search for gateways under metering/# for a few seconds.

gateway.title: Select gateway
gateway.description: Rubetek gateways were discovered in the metering namespace. Every configured meter_sn will be linked as a child device of the selected gateway.

manual_gateway.title: Gateway not discovered automatically
manual_gateway.description: The MQTT connection succeeded, but no metering/# message was received during discovery. Enter the gateway UUID manually.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the MQTT broker.
error.invalid_auth: The MQTT broker rejected the username or password.

abort.already_configured: This gateway is already configured in Rubetek MQTT.

menu_option_descriptions.add_device: Add an end meter by device type and meter_sn.
menu_option_descriptions.remove_device: Remove a previously configured end meter from this gateway.

add_device.title: Add device
add_device.description: A device is identified by its type and final meter_sn. The same physical meter heard by several gateways will not be duplicated.

error.invalid_serial: Enter a valid positive serial number.
error.already_configured: A device with this type and serial number is already configured.
